description: Cross-ticker canonical line-item mappings for consumer-staples tickers. Loaded alongside per-ticker decisions_ledger.json during reconcile; ticker-specific entries override generic ones. Row order is derived at model-write time from the latest filing's document order — this file does NOT carry model_row. Entries carry aliases for all known raw-filing wordings of the same canonical concept.
source_reference: CELH FY2024 10-K (latest available at migration time)

conventions.sign_agnostic_labels: Canonical labels use parentheticals for the alternative sign (e.g. 'Interest Income (Expense)') so values read correctly when they flip sign across companies or years.
conventions.filing_section_discriminator: For items that exist as both current and non-current (Note Receivable, Lease Liability, Deferred Revenue, etc.), paired entries share the same aliases and are disambiguated at reconcile time by the item's section tag.
conventions.filing_subsection_discriminator: For items with identical raw labels in different subsections (IS 'Basic'/'Diluted' as EPS vs shares_outstanding), filing_subsection picks the right entry.
conventions.memo: true means reconcile recognizes the item but model-write does NOT render it on the xlsx.
conventions.row_type_subtotal: true means model-write will overwrite the extracted value with a live SUM / cascade formula at render time.
